ops.body:
Fixed in capt-hook 8.18.0 (wave b1fafa07..d26e4ada, core commit 35fae210).

Mechanism: `Signals` gained kw-only `origin: Literal["assistant","any"]` with DEFAULT "assistant" (user picked the default-flip over per-hook stamps): transcript_texts now yields only AssistantEvent texts unless origin="any", and the UserPromptSubmit prompt-prepend is excluded under the default. consume_signals mirrors the pre-gate through one shared candidate-filter codepath so consumption cannot diverge. Stance hooks (stewardship, typing-warnings, deferral, detours, failure_recovery, code_quality) ride the default unstamped; the two legitimately user-text hooks are stamped origin="any" (packs/general/tasks.py distinct-requests — red-tested dead without the stamp — and docs/examples/corrections_nudge.py). Codex refuter enumerated every shipped Signals( construction and confirmed no other casualty. NLP clause tightening (issue+leave w2) was considered and dropped: live-verified the clause alone does NOT match the phrase; the false positive was origin, not synonyms.

Evidence: red-first inline test — the exact 8a7b6ed4 user-prose shape ("leave the login issue for now…") Warned pre-fix, Allows post-fix, while the identical text on an assistant-role event still Warns (proving origin, not phrasing, decides).
